meta.description: Redesign an outdated or slow website without losing your Google rankings. Kochi based team, full site audit first, redirects planned before launch.

body.text: Website redesign services from Teknoppy rebuild an existing website that no longer performs, whether it looks outdated, loads slowly, or simply is not bringing in the enquiries it used to. Kochi businesses come to us when their current site was built years ago, was never mobile friendly, or has fallen behind competitors who redesigned first. Every redesign project starts with an audit of what is actually broken across the site before a single design decision is made.

sections.trustline: 120+ Websites Delivered · In Kochi Since 2018 · Clients Across Kerala, UAE and Qatar

sections.h2: What Our Website Redesign Services Include

items.title: Website Revamp Services Kochi
items.text: A full website revamp covers structure, design, and content together, rebuilding the site around what your business actually offers today rather than patching over an old layout from a previous era.

items.title: Outdated Website Redesign
items.text: Many redesign projects start because the current site was built on old technology or an old template. We rebuild these from the ground up on a modern, secure foundation rather than layering fixes on top of an ageing system.

items.title: UI/UX Redesign for Existing Websites
items.text: Beyond visuals, this is about how visitors actually move through your site. Navigation, page layout, and call to action placement are redesigned around real user behaviour, not just a fresh colour scheme.

items.title: Content Migration During Redesign
items.text: This covers moving your existing pages, images, and blog posts into the new design with proper redirects in place, not platform or hosting migration, so a redesign does not mean starting your content and search visibility from zero.

items.title: Site Audit and Goal Setting.
items.text: We review your current site's performance, traffic, and weak points, and agree on what success looks like for the new version.

items.title: Content and SEO Mapping.
items.text: Every existing page is mapped to a new URL structure with redirects planned in advance, protecting the search visibility already built up.

items.title: Design and Structure Rebuild.
items.text: New wireframes and visual design are built around your current business goals, not the layout the old site happened to have.

items.title: Development and Testing.
items.text: The rebuilt site is developed, tested across devices, and checked against Core Web Vitals before anything goes live.

items.title: Launch and Post-Launch Monitoring.
items.text: We monitor rankings, traffic, and site speed closely in the weeks after launch to catch any issues early.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for Website Redesign Services in Kochi

items.title: We Protect Rankings, Not Just Looks
items.text: A website redesign without losing SEO rankings is the outcome we plan for from day one, not an afterthought handled after launch. URL mapping and redirects are built into the process before design work even begins.

items.title: We Redesign for Speed, Not Just Style
items.text: Redesign for slow or outdated websites is one of our most common project types. Where a previous developer left a heavy, slow loading site, our rebuild treats load speed as a core requirement, not a nice to have.

items.title: We've Rebuilt Sites Across Kochi and the GCC
items.text: Website redesign for Kochi and Kerala businesses is our core focus, and we've also handled ecommerce and business website redesign projects for clients in the UAE and Qatar, so regional buyer expectations shape the rebuild, not just local ones.

items.title: We Measure the Redesign, Not Just Deliver It
items.text: Website redesign conversion rate improvement is tracked after launch wherever analytics access allows, so you can see whether the new site is actually performing better, not just looking better.

sections.intro: This service fits any business whose current website is actively working against them, rather than for them, whether that shows up in traffic, enquiries, or simply how the site looks compared to competitors.

items.text: Businesses with a website more than three or four years old that no longer reflects their current offering or brand.
Businesses whose current site is slow, difficult to update, or was never built to work properly on mobile devices.
Businesses that need ecommerce and business website redesign because an old store or catalogue site is losing sales to newer competitors.

outro.html: This is especially common among established Kochi businesses and Kerala Business Blog readers who are actively researching a rebuild, as well as tourism, restaurant, and real estate businesses whose visual presentation directly affects daily enquiries.

paragraphs.text: We have rebuilt an outdated interior design studio website in Kochi that was suffering from poor user experience and stagnant enquiries, restructuring its portfolio pages and improving on-page SEO as part of the same project.

paragraphs.html: See more completed redesigns in our website design projects portfolio.

Website redesign cost in Kochi depends on how much of the existing site can be reused versus rebuilt from scratch, along with how many pages and how much content need migrating. For a full breakdown by scope, see our website design pricing page or try the website cost calculator.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Website Redesign Services Kochi

items.q: Will a website redesign affect my current SEO rankings?
items.a: Not if it is planned correctly. We map every existing URL to its new equivalent and set up proper redirects before launch, which is the main reason rankings can actually improve rather than drop after a redesign.

items.q: How do I know if my website needs a redesign rather than a maintenance fix?
items.a: If your site is slow, hard to update, not mobile friendly, or older than three to four years, a redesign usually delivers more value than ongoing patchwork fixes to an outdated foundation.

items.q: Can you redesign an ecommerce or business website without losing existing orders or data?
items.a: Yes, product data, customer records, and order history are migrated carefully as part of the process, with testing done before the new site fully replaces the old one.

items.q: How long does a website redesign project take?
items.a: Most redesigns take four to eight weeks depending on how many pages need migrating and how much new design and content work is involved.

items.q: Will my new website still be mobile friendly and fast?
items.a: Yes, every redesign is built mobile first and tested against Core Web Vitals benchmarks before launch, since this affects both user experience and search rankings.

items.q: Do you redesign websites built by another agency?
items.a: Yes, most of our redesign projects start with a site built by a previous developer or agency, and we begin every project with a full audit regardless of who built the original site.

sections.h2: Ready to Start Your Website Redesign Project?

paragraphs.text: An old website is quietly costing you enquiries every day it stays online. If your current site no longer reflects your business or is falling behind competitors, let's rebuild it around what your business needs today, not what it needed years ago.
